GET /api/session.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

schema.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Filter by parent session. Use null to return only root sessions.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

DELETE /api/session/{sessionID}.description: Delete a session and its child sessions.

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/interrupt.description: Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenCode process. Returns interrupted=true when an active execution was interrupted and false for the idle no-op. When resume=true, execution resumes pending steering input and next-in-line control items (manual compaction, moves) while queued prompts remain parked.

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this OpenCode process was interrupted.

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/prompt.description: Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.

GET /api/session/{sessionID}/message.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session, optionally filtered by type. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline, passing the same type filter on each page.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response. Do not combine with order.

schema.description: Filter by message type before pagination. When omitted, all message types are returned. Pass the same type when following cursors.

GET /api/session/{sessionID}/permission.description: Retrieve pending permission requests owned by a session.

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/permission.description: Evaluate and, when approval is required, create a permission request for a session.
Respond to a pending permission request owned by a session.

GET /api/permission/request.description: Retrieve pending permission requests for a location.

GET /api/permission/saved.description: Retrieve saved permissions, optionally filtered by project.

DELETE /api/permission/saved/{id}.description: Remove a saved permission by ID.

GET /api/event.description: Subscribe to native events and plugin RPC events across all server locations. Volatile by contract: a slow consumer overflows and fails the stream, and events during disconnection are missed.

GET /api/form.description: Retrieve pending forms for a location.

GET /api/session/{sessionID}/form.description: Retrieve pending forms for a session.

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/form.description: Create a form for a session.

GET /api/session/{sessionID}/form/{formI.description: Retrieve a form and its current state for a session.

DELETE /api/session/{sessionID}/form/{fo.description: Cancel a pending form, optionally telling the asker why it was not answered.

POST /api/session/{sessionID}/form/{form.description: Submit an answer to a pending form.

SessionsCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this OpenCode process was interrupted.
